nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Family Doge'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'FDoge'.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals (18).
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address => uint) storing per-address token balances.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, total supply and assigning all tokens to msg.sender.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).
View function returning the balance of a given token owner from balances mapping.
View function returning the remaining allowance for a spender from the allowed mapping.
Function granting a spender an allowance of tokens from msg.sender.
Function transferring tokens from msg.sender to a recipient, updating balances via SafeMath.
Function transferring tokens on behalf of 'from' using the caller's allowance, updating balances and allowed via SafeMath.
SafeMath function performing overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath function performing underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath function performing overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath function performing division with zero-check.
Caller-controlled address used as the token owner, allowance owner and initial supply recipient.
Subtraction of tokens from balances[msg.sender] inside transfer (arithmetic-sensitive).
Addition of tokens to balances[to] inside transfer/transferFrom (arithmetic-sensitive).
Subtraction of tokens from allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom (arithmetic-sensitive).
Native unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply (arithmetic-sensitive).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, used as key into balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance, used as first key into allowed mapping.
Parameter spender of allowance, used as second key into allowed mapping.
Parameter spender of approve, the address receiving the allowance.
Parameter tokens of approve, the allowance amount written into allowed.
Parameter to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the address whose tokens are debited.
Parameter to of transferFrom, the recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved.
First addend parameter a of safeAdd.
Second addend parameter b of safeAdd.
Local result variable c of safeAdd.
Minuend parameter a of safeSub.
Subtrahend parameter b of safeSub.
Local result variable c of safeSub.
First factor parameter a of safeMul.
Second factor parameter b of safeMul.
Local result variable c of safeMul.
Dividend parameter a of safeDiv.
Divisor parameter b of safeDiv.
Local result variable c of safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token name to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns 18 to the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the entire supply into balances for the deployer.
msg.sender is used as the key when initializing its balance in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender's balance is the value reduced by the subtraction in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply feeds _totalSupply and balances[address(0)] into the unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the mapping key in balanceOf.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the first key into allowed.
spender parameter is used as the second key into allowed.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
spender parameter determines the allowance entry owner in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
The tokens argument flows directly into the allowed mapping as the new allowance value.
transfer debits msg.sender via the subtraction operation.
transfer credits the recipient via the addition operation.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
to parameter is used as the recipient key in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from the sender balance.
to parameter determines the balance entry credited in transfer.
transferFrom debits the caller allowance via the subtraction operation.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
from parameter is used as the debited balance key in transferFrom.
to parameter is used as the credited balance key in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the operand added to the recipient balance.
tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from the allowance.
The balance debit operation executes safeSub.
The balance credit operation executes safeAdd.
The allowance debit operation executes safeSub.
safeAdd binds its first argument to parameter a.
safeAdd binds its second argument to parameter b.
safeAdd writes its result into local variable c.
safeSub binds its first argument to parameter a.
safeSub binds its second argument to parameter b.
safeSub writes its result into local variable c.
safeMul binds its first argument to parameter a.
safeMul binds its second argument to parameter b.
safeMul writes its result into local variable c.
safeDiv binds its first argument to parameter a.
safeDiv binds its second argument to parameter b.
safeDiv writes its result into local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: Token owner parameter exists only to index the balances mapping read inside balanceOf.
Token owner parameter exists only to index the allowed mapping read inside allowance.
Spender parameter exists only to index the allowed mapping read inside allowance.
Spender parameter only selects the allowance slot written by approve.
Tokens parameter only supplies the allowance value written by approve.
Recipient parameter only selects the balance entry credited by the addition operation.
Tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from the sender balance.
From parameter selects the balance and allowance entries debited by transferFrom.
Recipient parameter only selects the balance entry credited by the addition operation.
Tokens parameter is the operand subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
First addend is a temporary binding of the safeAdd operation.
Second addend is a temporary binding of the safeAdd operation.
Local result c is the direct output of the safeAdd operation.
Minuend is a temporary binding of the safeSub operation.
Subtrahend is a temporary binding of the safeSub operation.
Local result c is the direct output of the safeSub operation.
First factor is a temporary binding of the safeMul operation.
Second factor is a temporary binding of the safeMul operation.
Local result c is the direct output of the safeMul operation.
Dividend is a temporary binding of the safeDiv operation.
Divisor is a temporary binding of the safeDiv operation.
Local result c is the direct output of the safeDiv operation.
